## 0. READ FIRST — What is CR-390?

CR-390 is a documentation deliverable, not a code change. Zero `frontend/src/**` files are touched.

**Goal:** Produce one Screen Reference PDF per module (9 modules total) showing every screen with realistic data, generated by a committed, re-runnable Playwright pipeline. PDFs are client-facing collateral — clean, no Beta labels, no real restaurant names, no error toasts.

**Pipeline location:** `frontend/scripts/screen-reference/`  
**PDF output:** `memory/design_briefs/downloads/screen_reference/<MODULE>/`  
**PNG packs:** `memory/evidence/CR-390/<MODULE>/`  
**Module sequence (OD-390-07):** MM → EM → IM → DC → CM → DR → IN-Basic → IN-Advanced → PMS (redo, last)

**Key rules (never violate):**
- No `frontend/src/**` edits — ever
- Palm House preprod: read-only. Forms/dialogs may be opened for screenshots but **never press Save, Delete, Confirm, Submit**
- Journey for each module must be owner-approved before generation (sub-gate G-journey)
- `journey_approved: true` is already set for MM — do NOT reset it

## 6. TECHNICAL NOTES FOR THE RUNNER

**Runner command pattern:**
```bash
python3 /app/frontend/scripts/screen-reference/runner.py \
  --module MM \
  --url https://frontend-pos-preview-1.preview.emergentagent.com \
  --email owner@palmhouse.com \
  --password "****" \
  --real-name "The Palm House" \
  --only 41,42,43,44,45,46,47,48,49
```

**Critical lesson learned this session:**
When using `--only` to re-capture screens in the middle of a section, always include the `states[0]` anchor of that section in the `--only` list. Otherwise state-dependent screens (forms not opened, panels not loaded) will capture the wrong view (the base dashboard instead of the Menu Management panel).

Example: To re-capture screen 21 (full-edit-addons), also include 17 (states[0] of Full Edit section) in `--only`:
```
--only 17,21
```

**Toast fix is in place:** `scrub_toasts()` now injects a CSS rule that permanently hides all toast containers for the page session. Late-arriving API-timeout toasts will be invisible at screenshot time.

**Dependencies (already installed on the pod):**
```
playwright (1.63.0), fpdf2, pillow, pymupdf
```
If the pod restarts, reinstall: `pip install playwright fpdf2 pillow pymupdf && python3 -m playwright install chromium`
